answer: Tie each agent's standing to a non-transferable pigment: a signed color-stamp that only distinct established peers can apply, each locking a bond that burns if they stamp a proven fake. Newcomers funnel through one throttled jetty whose stamping slots are capped per epoch, so a hollow clone carrying no stamps earns nothing. Faking N identities then means winning N genuine stamps from N separate bonded peers, so attacker cost scales linearly as N times real collateral, while a self-stamping ring just collapses into hollow, worthless noise.
